_comment: Diagnostic external-listener pool: Claude Sonnet 5 at medium effort. NOT the frozen eval suite -- that is configs/guesser_pool_llm_opus.json, and evaluation results come only from there (docs/iteration-architecture.md's 'two roles for guessers'). This pool is for paid-but-cheaper head-to-head diagnostics and for parameter selection: it is the listener expected_words' sigma=2.5 was chosen against (scripts/tools/sweep_sigma.py --model claude-sonnet-5:medium, see docs/versions/expected_words.md). 'effort' is part of the response-cache key (codenames/guessers/llm.py::cache_model_id), so changing it here will not silently reuse rankings produced at a different effort -- it will re-bill instead. Shares cache/llm_store.db with the Opus and Haiku entries; keyed by model+effort, so no collision.
